summary: Kept DFM User Entry formulas editable when validation fails or an Excel reference cannot be checked.
details: Validation errors now use an overlaid formula-bar tooltip—normally above, with a below-bar fallback—without shifting the Ratios tables, while other Ratios command errors use the in-page notice instead of native alerts that can break Windows input focus.
Formula drafts and caret selections remain available for correction, and stalled Excel checks release the formula bar after 30 seconds.
Excel range addresses continue to normalize their column letters to uppercase before persistence.
